data.songTitle: Luke Combs - Be By You (Official Lyric Video)
data.albumName: Luke Combs - Be By You (Official Lyric Video)
data.plainLyric:
Kinda like an old Jon boat on some largemouth water
Kinda like that breeze that blows through a sweet home holler
I can't leave your lovin' alone
Where you are is where I belong

I hope I ain't comin' on too strong
Just wanna hold you close, baby
Kinda looks like you do too
I just wanna make love, wake up
Next to you in no makeup, baby
Nothin' beats that view
I guess what it comes down to
Is I just wanna be by you

Love it when your fancy blues slide to the middle
I'm stuck to you like glue on your hip like a pistol
Wanna find me, you ain't gotta look far
There's nothin' that can pull us apart

I hope I ain't comin' on too strong
Just wanna hold you close, baby
Kinda looks like you do too
I just wanna make love, wake up
Next to you in no makeup, baby
Nothin' beats that view
I guess what it comes down to
Is I just wanna be by you

If the day ends in Y
If the sun or the moon's hangin' up in the sky

I hope I ain't comin' on too strong
Just wanna hold you close, baby
Kinda looks like you do too
I just wanna make love, wake up
Next to you in no makeup, baby
Nothin' beats that view
I guess what it comes down to
Is I just wanna be by you
